name: paint_colors_tsv
label: CSS named colors + relative luminance
value_label: Relative luminance computed from the color's hex (0.0 = black, 1.0 = white)
provenance: WS-4 dual-output demo, added 2026-07-24 on branch claude/next-item-v4te8p and kept during that day's consolidation (a near-identical copy from a second branch was deduped away). Tab-separated name<TAB>value. Names and hex values are the standardised CSS Color Module Level 4 extended keyword list, with scripts/build_paint_colors.py as the source of truth and regenerator; the value is not an external fact but is computed from the hex by that script using the standard relative-luminance formula, so it is internally consistent by construction. Sidecar is named paint_colors_tsv.meta.json rather than paint_colors.meta.json because data/paint_colors.txt - an unrelated WS-1 dataset - already owns that stem.
